name: bombot-forge
description: BomBot's NetSuite delivery forge — personal Claude Code skills for shipping SuiteScript safely: SDF prod deploy (import-compare-confirm + temp-authid trap + guardrails), live read-only verification via Dev Bridge / dbgQuery (accounts/GL/fields/script-deployment + SuiteQL gotchas), scoped record writes via a browser helper (ns_write: submitFields + load/save, structured args, account guard, dry-run, allow-rule validation; bsk engine for sandbox with dialog guard and unknown-outcome stop, cdp engine anywhere), turning an account-owned bundle into a version-controlled SDF repo (Convert to SDF Project, legacy scriptid Change ID, path-fidelity rules), transcribing video/audio to SRT/TXT/MD via the homelab bombot MCP (Tailscale bridge to the bombot-pc GPU box: Taildrop in, size verify, one transcribe_video call that outlives its client timeout, Taildrop back; the .md is a summary, not a transcript), browser driving with bsk (BrowserSkill) then Claude in Chrome — own session + pinned tab, cooperate sync, dialog guard, NetSuite identity gate, bounded observe, how the Dev Bridge works, a first-run walkthrough (the old cdp lane recorded as history in docs, no longer a skill), syncing a machine's global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md to a redacted reference snapshot (compare + section-merge, never blind-overwrite), setup + checker for the default local-llm worker (Ollama on the tailnet GPU box, reached through the bombot bridge), a teibto-agent subagent that hands edits to the coding-agent CLI on the company DeepSeek key (the older teibto-worker subagent, /teibto-worker, /teibto-code and setup-teibto-worker are deprecated; the TEIBTO key step, ask_cheap.py helper and price table now live in setup-coding-agent, key per machine, never in the repo), and a setup-coding-agent (Cline/OpenCode as the worker, worktree-isolated run helper, Claude briefs and reviews), an interactive setup-browser (bsk plus optional Claude in Chrome, offers to remove an old cdp setup, Dev Bridge trial, login-click consent), setup-init (new-machine checklist that runs the setup skills in order) and setup-cli (git + GitHub CLI for everyone; SuiteCloud CLI, SDF project and team-format auth id for devs), building verified stakeholder decision briefs, and capture-artifact (after a deploy: red-boxed live screenshots with captions; --local keeps them in the project out of git via .git/info/exclude, otherwise saved to a new Drive subfolder with README, added as a wide gallery to the decision-log artifact, Slack summary drafted in chat for review when there is a thread, never sent without OK; needs bsk).
